statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33748 (GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg, GO-2026-4859): before 0.28.1, github.com/moby/buildkit does not fully validate the subdir component of a Git URL fragment, which can give access to files outside the checked-out repository on the same filesystem. It is fixed in 0.28.1: https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg, https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.28.1. Read the Go build information of every Go program in every published build-fips package for Alpine 3.23 (2.6.4-r0 to 2.28.0-r5, 86 versions, x86_64 and aarch64, from the DHI FIPS package repository); its Go programs are /usr/bin/build in every build, /opt/docker/dhi/yq from 2.26.2-r1 and /usr/bin/dhi-source from 2.28.0-r1. Every build before 2.9.2-r0 contains github.com/moby/buildkit 0.26.3, inside the affected range; 2.9.2-r0 and every later build contain 0.28.1 to 0.33.0, which carry the fix. /opt/docker/dhi/yq does not contain the module.

GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg (CVE-2026-33748, GO-2026-4859): a crafted subdirectory component in a Git URL given to BuildKit could reach files outside the checked-out repository. Fixed in github.com/moby/buildkit 0.28.1 by https://github.com/moby/buildkit/commit/45b038cd0b2ec2d34013ce0f085522276f7ee0d8 (git: normalize and validate subdir paths): https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg. The trivy-fips packages are published in the DHI security repository, which requires authentication, and their Go build information has not been read build by build for this advisory. Pending: reading /usr/bin/trivy in each published build of this package to find the first build that embeds github.com/moby/buildkit 0.28.1 or newer, so that a fixed boundary can be set from what each build ships. The non-FIPS trivy package of the same releases embeds it from 0.69.3-r4 on.

GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg (CVE-2026-33748, GO-2026-4859): a crafted subdirectory component in a Git URL given to BuildKit could reach files outside the checked-out repository. Fixed in github.com/moby/buildkit 0.28.1 by https://github.com/moby/buildkit/commit/45b038cd0b2ec2d34013ce0f085522276f7ee0d8 (git: normalize and validate subdir paths): https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-4vrq-3vrq-g6gg. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program for Linux that keeps its symbol table. We read its Go build information (go version -m) and its function table in all 38 trivy builds published for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 as of 2026-11-27 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r12) and in 10 of them on aarch64 (0.69.1-r0, 0.69.3-r0, 0.69.3-r1, 0.69.3-r2, 0.69.3-r3, 0.69.3-r4, 0.69.3-r5, 0.70.0-r3, 0.70.0-r4 and 0.74.0-r12); where both architectures of a build were read, they report the same Go release and module versions. trivy uses BuildKit as a library to parse Dockerfiles: in every build read, the function table holds buildkit's frontend/dockerfile/parser functions and no functions from its executor, source/git or source/http packages, which hold the daemon-side code that 0.28.1 changes. The range follows the embedded module version: 0.69.1-r0 to 0.69.3-r3 embed github.com/moby/buildkit 0.26.2, inside the affected range, and 0.69.3-r4 is the first build that embeds 0.28.1; every later build read embeds 0.28.1 or newer, up to 0.32.2 in 0.74.0-r12.
